messages:
jess: FYI we have a customer report — production app saw a cascade of 403s and spiking tail latency. They say calls are bouncing between EU and US endpoints and some requests are completing twice.
ramon: Any repro steps or logs from the client?
jess: Pasting the trimmed client log they sent: shows first attempt -> us-central-1, timeout, then retry to eu-west-1 within ~800ms, second request succeeds but first later returns 403.
ramon: Can you paste their SDK config?
jess: They provided this snippet from their config file:
```json
{"regionPreference": ["us-central-1","eu-west-1"], "maxRetries": 4, "retryMode": "aggressive", "hedgedRequests": true, "timeoutMs": 900}
```
nina: That combination is risky — short timeout + hedgedRequests + aggressive retryMode will cause the client to fire fallback requests across regions instead of waiting, especially on tail spikes.
elena_oncall: I checked our traces for tenant abc-331: request id req_abc123 shows primary latency jump ~600ms then a hedged request to eu fired at ~850ms; token refresh overlapped and produced a 403 on one path.
matt_sdk: SDK maintainer here — hedgedRequests was intended to target local replicas only. There's a failure in the region-fallback ordering when regionPreference is set that can pick the next region in the list instead of staying local. I'll open a PR.
sarah_pd: Do we have customer impact (errors + billing)? Could the double completion trigger duplicate billing?
ramon: From logs it looks like two successful completions for the same logical call were recorded in different regions -> finance will need to review duplicate charges.
jess: Repro steps the customer shared (concise):
1) Configure region preference with backup region
2) Configure hedgedRequests=true and timeoutMs < typical tail
3) Induce ~500-800ms tail on primary
4) Observe hedged request to backup region which completes before primary

nina: Short-term mitigations to recommend to customer: set "hedgedRequests": false, or increase "timeoutMs" to >2000 and reduce "maxRetries" to 1. Also pin region if they need strict locality.
matt_sdk: Action plan from SDK side: patch region-ordering bug, add explicit single-region pin flag, and make hedgedRequests opt-in to same-region only. ETA: PR in ~4h, canary rollout afterwards.
elena_oncall: I added a temporary routing override for this tenant to prefer their pinned region for the next 2 hours while we validate. Monitoring metrics for cross-region calls now.
ramon: Support action list: (1) Send remediation notes to customer (disable hedged / raise timeout). (2) Open billing escalation ticket for potential duplicate charges and freeze disputed billing until review. (3) Track SDK PR + canary and update customer when patched.
jess: I'll draft the customer message and run it by @sarah_pd for billing wording. :slightly_smiling_face:
deploy-bot: deploy started for sdk/region-order-fix at commit abcdef -> canary
matt_sdk: thanks — watching canary and will post PR link here when ready.
